title: Cherubinischer Wandersmann (German)
author: Angelus Silesius
description: Angelus Silesius's German collection of mystical epigrams presents spiritual reflection in brief, paradoxical verse. Its poems explore union with God, inward transformation and the limits of ordinary religious language.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. Source text obtained from the Internet Archive (https://archive.org/details/desangelussilesi00angeuoft).
rights: From the curator's private collection. Publication rights for this edition are to be confirmed before public release.
